title: Apply for a paintball venue permit
summary: Use this page to apply for a paintball venue permit for your business.
intro:
You need a paintball venue permit to:

Each paintball venue requires a separate paintball venue permit.

Permits can be for 1, 3 or 5 years.
who_can_apply: Pass a 'fit and proper' person assessment
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a paintball venue permit'
The PDF form: 'Paintball permit additional details form' (if applicable)
Your business details, including names of any directors, body corporate, partnership or sole trader
The address of each paintball venue
Council approval to operate a paintball venue
Payment for the fee (the fee is the same for 1, 3, or 5-year permits)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Paintball permit additional details form – PDF if applicable.
Submit your payment online and enter the receipt number on the application form.
Email the form and supporting documents using the details on the form, or visit a Service NSW Centre to submit in person.

more_info.text: the NSW Police General Firearms Course for Long Arms, if they were employed as a supervisor before 1 December 2021
the NSW Paintball Marker Safety Training course, if they were employed as a supervisor on or after 1 December 2021.

faqs.q: How many permits do I need?
faqs.a: Each paintball venue requires a separate paintball venue permit.

faqs.q: What are the permit lengths available?
faqs.a: Permits can be for 1, 3, or 5 years.

faqs.q: How can I submit my application?
faqs.a: You can email the form and supporting documents using the details on the form, or visit a Service NSW Centre to submit in person.
